subject.title: Adopt the core durable ingress drain on the remaining channels (WhatsApp, Discord, Slack, Signal, iMessage)

question: Should this umbrella continue to require a durable-drain migration for iMessage, and which of WhatsApp or Discord should receive the next credentialed proof and implementation slot?
rationale: The shared seam is already available, but the current plan records different transport contracts: WhatsApp is blocked on live credentials, Discord is a later wave, and iMessage already has a durable cursor. Those are product and reliability-policy choices rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Continue channel-by-channel
options.body: Prioritize WhatsApp once its QA credential is restored, then review Discord as an isolated adapter with transport-specific replay proof; retain iMessage as a separate decision.

options.title: Narrow the umbrella
options.body: Track only channels with a demonstrated receive-to-adoption loss window here and close or split the iMessage uniformity request into a smaller product discussion.

options.title: Require full uniformity
options.body: Commit to migrating iMessage as well, after defining what the drain adds beyond its durable cursor and how duplicate and age-fence behavior will be preserved.

recommendation.title: Continue channel-by-channel
recommendation.body: Prioritize WhatsApp once its QA credential is restored, then review Discord as an isolated adapter with transport-specific replay proof; retain iMessage as a separate decision.

likelyOwner.reason: The active plan, wave sequencing, and prerequisite live-proof status are documented in this person's current issue updates and related merged work.
